summary.text: The Simic Combine is the green-blue guild of Ravnica, devoted to biomancy, medicine and the creation of new life forms.

bio.text: Momir Vig became guildmaster and sought to enhance life through experimentation, creating cytoplasts.
The Simic and Golgari activated Project Kraj during the Dissension, and afterward the Simic remained leaderless.
With the rediscovery of the oceans through the Zonots, the Simic were remade from scratch, rejecting Vig's philosophy, and Zegana became guildmaster.
Zegana delivered the Fathom Edict declaring the merfolk to be the Simic, and many resurfaced merfolk joined the guild.
Vannifar was voted the new Prime Speaker, and the whole guild aligned with the adaptationists under her.
In the War of the Spark, Ral Zarek convinced the Simic to join the fight against Bolas, and Vorel led them into battle against the Dreadhorde.

During the Phyrexian invasion many Simic willingly underwent compleation, which caused distrust from other guilds, and afterward the Simic offered healing treatments to victims of partial compleation.

status.text: The guild is led by Prime Speaker Vannifar, and in the latest story the Simic are said to have trapped Ruric Thar with poisoned lamb.
